The '''Swallow Mud Marsh''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] surrounded by a dense, overgrown [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The swamp was part of the [[Grabvine Gateway/Legends|Grabvine Gateway]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course.
